title: Spread geometric irreducibility of one finite type generic fibre
statement: Let $f:X\to T$ be a finite type morphism of schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $\eta$ be a generic point of $T$. Suppose the scheme-theoretic fibre $X_\eta$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre] is geometrically irreducible over $\kappa(\eta)$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. Then there is an open $U\subseteq T$ containing $\eta$ such that $X_t$ is geometrically irreducible over $\kappa(t)$ for every $t\in U$. Geometric irreducibility includes nonemptiness after every field extension.

proof.text: Choose an affine base neighbourhood V of η. Geometric irreducibility makes X_η nonempty. Choose a point x in that fibre and an affine source neighbourhood W of its image contained in f⁻¹(V). The fibre inclusion is an open immersion; its source is nonempty. Over Spec κ(η) its structure map is surjective, so Mathlib’s open-subscheme instance makes W_η geometrically irreducible. These constructions and instance applications are proved in Lean.
Apply the geometric-fibre density theorem to f and W, giving a neighbourhood U₁ on which every geometric fibre inclusion has dense range.
Apply the affine-source geometric irreducibility theorem to W.ι≫f; its image lies in V by construction. Obtain a neighbourhood U₂ on which the fibres of the chart are geometrically irreducible.

Take U=U₁∩U₂. For every residue-field test at t∈U, the chart pullback is irreducible and its map into the original pullback is continuous with dense range. Its image is irreducible, and the closure of that image is the whole pullback. Hence the whole geometric fibre is irreducible. The complete construction of the canonical double pullback map and this closure argument are proved in Lean.
